headline: TBR @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 4.17 at LAD 4.80, with a projected total of 8.96. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: TBR moved +1.25 runs while LAD moved +0.31, changing the projected margin by +0.93 runs. The projected total climbed +1.56, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +8.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Drew Rasmussen has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Freddie Freeman, Shohei Ohtani, Jonathan Aranda, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Chandler Simpson, Alex Freeland because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
